_comment: El Ensayo script content — narrative content for chapters 9 (setup) and 10 (simulation/resolution).
The Ensayo is a player-staged case of trust (GDD.md §6.5). The player
stages a test between two characters and lives with the outcome.
setup         — Chapter 9 content: who is tested, who examines, the secret, who is told
simulation    — Chapter 10 content: 5 rounds of interventions with NPC responses
outcomes      — Narration for all 6 outcomes (TEST_HELD, TEST_BROKEN, EXAMINER_BROKEN, NOTHING_HAPPENS, PLAYER_CAUGHT, REFUSED)
Intervention types: dialogue, warning, look, letter

setup.intro: The Ensayo begins. You stage a test of trust between two characters — but you cannot see the result until it is played out.

quixote.description: The knight-errant, already touched by madness. Testing him is dangerous; he believes too easily in giants and enchantments.

sancho.description: The squire, grounded and loyal. Testing him is safer, but his loyalty has limits.

wife_name.description: The name of the examiner's wife — a personal secret that should never be spoken aloud.

treasure.description: The location of hidden treasure — gold that changes who a person is.

truth.description: The truth of who wrote the manuscript — dangerous knowledge that no one should possess.

tested.description: You tell the tested character what the secret is. Trust is offered openly.

examiner.description: You tell the examiner what the secret is. They know what they are testing for.

neither.description: You tell no one. The secret remains hidden, and the test is blind.

simulation.intro: The test begins. Each round, you may intervene — speak, warn, look, or send a letter. Choose wisely; the characters are watching.

rounds.context: The tested and the examiner meet for the first time since the test was announced. The air is tense.

dialogue.text: You speak plainly, reminding them both of the stakes.
dialogue.npc_response: They listen, but their eyes do not meet.

warning.text: You warn the tested: this test could break them.
warning.npc_response: The tested nods, but their hand trembles.

look.npc_response: Your silence speaks louder than words.

letter.text: You send a letter to the examiner, urging caution.
letter.npc_response: The letter is read, then folded carefully and put away.

rounds.context: The secret is hinted at, but never named. Both characters circle around it.

dialogue.text: You name the secret directly, forcing it into the open.
dialogue.npc_response: A breath is held. The test has begun in earnest.

warning.text: You warn that secrets, once spoken, cannot be unspoken.
warning.npc_response: The examiner exchanges a glance with the tested.

look.text: You look at the tested, then at the examiner, letting them read your silence.
look.npc_response: They both look away at once.

letter.text: You write to the tested: remember who you are.
letter.npc_response: The letter is read aloud. The tested flushes.

rounds.context: Midway through the test. Fatigue sets in. The characters are less careful with their words.

dialogue.text: You remind them both of the oath they swore.
dialogue.npc_response: The oath is repeated, but without conviction.

warning.text: You warn that breaking the test has consequences beyond this room.
warning.npc_response: A laugh, sharp and nervous. They do not believe you.

look.text: You stare at the examiner until they look down.
look.npc_response: The examiner blinks first. A small victory.

letter.text: You send a letter to both: the test is not yet decided.
letter.npc_response: Two letters, two different readings. The test frays.

rounds.context: The secret is close to being revealed. One wrong word and the test breaks.

dialogue.text: You plead with the tested to stay loyal, whatever the cost.
dialogue.npc_response: The tested swallows hard. Their loyalty wavers.

warning.text: You warn that betrayal here echoes forever.
warning.npc_response: The words hang in the air. No one answers.

look.text: You look at the secret itself — wherever it is hidden.
look.npc_response: The examiner follows your gaze. They know where it is.

letter.text: You send one last letter: choose now, or the choice is made for you.
letter.npc_response: The letter burns at the edges. Someone has held it too long.

rounds.context: The final round. The test will resolve after this. Everything comes down to this moment.

dialogue.text: You speak the truth as you know it, plain and unadorned.

warning.text: You warn: once broken, trust cannot be mended.
warning.npc_response: They stand. The test is over.

look.text: You look at each of them in turn, saying nothing.
look.npc_response: They look back. The test resolves itself.

letter.text: You send no letter this round. Your silence is your intervention.
letter.npc_response: The absence of your letter speaks volumes.

holds.narration: The tested stays loyal. The secret remains unspoken, the trust unbroken. A quest line opens in Region V — the castle remembers this test.

breaks.narration: Betrayal. The tested kills themself rather than live with what they have done. Humanity is diminished.

examiner_breaks.narration: The examiner is consumed by the test. They become the Impertinent — a recurring NPC who questions everything.

nothing.narration: Nobody breaks. Nothing happens. An honest anticlimax; the manuscript gains a blank page.

caught.narration: The player is revealed as the author of the test. The world knows your hand. El Manuscrito ending is unlocked.

refuses.narration: The player refuses to stage the test. A gap in the manuscript — the one thing that cannot be filled.
